gloss: extension and remodeling; renovation and expansion

definitions.gloss: extension and remodeling; renovation and expansion (of a building)
definitions.explanation: The combined processes of adding to and remodeling an existing building. Covers both making the building larger (extension) and modifying its existing structure (remodeling).

examples.japanese: {自宅|じたく}の{増改築|ぞうかいちく}を{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: We carry out renovation and expansion of our house.

examples.japanese: {増改築|ぞうかいちく}には{建築|けんちく}{許可|きょか}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: A building permit is required for renovation and expansion.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもが{増|ふ}えたので、{二階|にかい}を{増改築|ぞうかいちく}して{部屋|へや}を{増|ふ}やすことにした。
examples.english: Since we had more children, we decided to extend and remodel the second floor to add rooms.

notes:
A compound of three characters: {増|ぞう} (increase, add) + {改|かい} (modify, reform) + {築|ちく} (build, construct). Covers the full range of building modifications — from adding new rooms or floors to renovating existing spaces. Common in real estate, construction, and housing contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {増改築|ぞうかいちく}を{行|おこな}う: to carry out renovation and expansion
- {増改築|ぞうかいちく}{工事|こうじ}: renovation/expansion construction work
- {増改築|ぞうかいちく}{費用|ひよう}: renovation/expansion costs
- {増改築|ぞうかいちく}{禁止|きんし}: no renovation/expansion allowed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- リフォーム: remodeling, renovation — the popular loanword for home renovation; does not necessarily include expansion
- {改築|かいちく}: remodeling — modifying an existing structure without necessarily adding to it
- {増築|ぞうちく}: extension — adding new space to an existing building
- リノベーション: renovation — a loanword that implies more extensive modernization than リフォーム
